name: Silbarrel Silbarella
original_name: シルバレル・シルバレラ
source:
Silbarrel Silbarella is an infamously ugly individual originally from the Free Cities Alliance. Her first appearance was in Rance 4.1, where she works as the chief of dorms in Happiness Pharmaceutical. Rance considers her his greatest foe, due to the great fear it inspires in him to just look at her. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Silbarrel_Silbarella]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
